message: No detected input validation: No schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards are visible anywhere in the data acquisition path; data is loaded and used directly without validation.

No detected untrusted source handling: The code only reads from local file paths (e.g., 'data/train.csv', local checkpoint directories) with no remote fetching, checksum verification, or authentication visible.

No detected label flipping detection: There is no code that validates label distributions, checks label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool before or during training.

No detected data poisoning defenses: No outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious training samples is implemented anywhere in the visible data preparation or training pipeline code.

No detected model integrity verification: The load_checkpoint function loads model weights via torch.load without any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision; no integrity verification is performed before loading.
No detected label distribution validation: There is no code that checks class balance, validates expected label sets, or detects anomalous training samples before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: The training loop has no backdoor defenses such as trigger detection, activation analysis, or gradient anomaly detection.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries (e.g., Opacus, TF Privacy) or DP-SGD mechanisms are imported or used anywhere in the code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) or any robustness stress testing are used anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: While a separate validation set is used, there is no hashing/signing of evaluation data, no isolation enforcement, and only a single combined accuracy metric is reported without independent verification mechanisms.
No detected input sanitization: The test_inference function directly passes data from the data_loader into the model without any shape, range, or schema validation checks.

No detected output bounds checks: The inference path (test_inference) accumulates outputs into test_fc_dict without any NaN guards, probability bounds checks, or threshold validation on model outputs.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a computer vision classification pipeline (not an LLM), so prompt injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
